subtitle: WORLD ATLAS OVERDRIVE — ORIGINAL CARTOGRAPHY, ICON PINS, MANUAL MISSION OVERLAYS & FAST IPHONE MODE
changes: World Atlas Overdrive v18 replaces the flat illustrative map background with a detailed, original standalone SVG continental chart, including richer coastline relief, mountains, forests, labels and a separate Outland portal inset.

Built a dual-level interactive map experience: existing eight world-region pins and a new selected-region icon chart for all 25 curated real WoW-named destinations, with capital, hub and zone iconography.

Overlaid the original manual mission statuses (in progress, planned, manually completed), bookmark stars, local mission counts and v17 session markers—without implying real gameplay position, achievement or ownership.
Introduced map filters for all destinations, local mission zones, individual manual statuses, bookmarks, v17 session destinations, capitals, hubs and zones.

Added source-labeled location intelligence cards showing existing local missions and character, Forge draft and Item Atlas links, with direct Expedition Console and Adventure Operations handoffs, native mission creation and bookmark controls.
Added optional user-selected local PNG/JPEG/WebP map previews (8 MB limit) with object URL revocation and instant reset. Images never upload, persist, or claim automatic alignment with map markers.

Added a cinematic/performance toggle that reduces rendering effects for iPhone and reduced-motion users; all map icons are original compact inline SVG and the map image is bundled locally without third-party scripts or map-tile calls.
Provided an external Warcraft Wiki map-reference link for players who want to inspect actual in-game map artwork rather than pretend the NEXUS coordinate chart is official.

Retained the existing v16 Atlas and v16.5 bookmark/planner storage, v17 Operations, original saved items, Forge ranks, Blizzard account verification, Cloudflare Workers, music and other studios; no new local storage key is introduced.

Included new pure source regressions, synthetic desktop Chromium/iPhone-style WebKit map tests, original map art documentation and rollback branch backup/azeroth-v17-before-world-atlas-v18-2026-11-17.
Owner approval covers publication. Real physical iPhone/device, connected account, live game and external game-map reference acceptance remain pending and are not falsely marked verified.
Introduced Sovereign Adventure Operations v17: a separate cinematic multi-mission session workspace that references existing v16 World Atlas missions without editing their records.
Players can order up to 18 manual Atlas goals into a private session, reorder tasks, set optional personal time estimates, title/day/focus character and attach personal objective/field notes.

Added read-only source-aware status for existing v16.5 checklist progress, locally saved characters, native Talent Forge draft references and Item Atlas identifiers; missing links are shown as unavailable, never invented.

Created whitelisted portable JSON session exports with manual source labels, optional plain-text copy, import previews and explicit confirmation. Imports overwrite only the independent v17 session key.
Added cross-tab write conflict protection to prevent silent stale-session overwrites, bounded notes/date/estimate validation, and clear-session confirmation preserving all old missions and builds.
Linked the new operations room from Command Center, World Atlas, Expedition Console, Character Nexus and main Companion navigation, plus browser-local Command Search.
Preserved approved violet/gold/cyan panoramic art with a responsive cinematic illustrated desktop/iPhone layout, keyboard-visible focus, reduced-motion support and standalone iPhone app metadata.

Owner approval authorizes publication while real iPhone, Battle.net account, in-game player and Discord-delivery acceptance stay pending until independently checked.

Added seven practical activity-specific mission-preparation templates, user-customizable manual checklists (20-step cap), progress percentages representing only checked personal actions, reset confirmation and persistent private strategy notes.

Introduced owner-local priority, pinned missions, character/status filters and goal search without inventing game-ready ratings, combat performance, loot outcomes, confirmed quest completion or official encounter guides.

Provided user-directed exportable JSON Expedition Briefs and copyable manual checklist text (where clipboard permission allows), with whitelisted fields and warnings to review personal notes before sharing.

No changes to allocation engine, saved builds, input mappings, undo/redo, checkpoint writes, OAuth, Blizzard authentication, account data or Cloudflare configuration. The Icon Ascension module performs no localStorage writes.
